prompts.fish: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied turquoise drawn scout fish. Make the fish subtly alert and look DOWN AND LEFT toward a friendly visitor below its snout: change the pupils and eyelids only, open eyes looking down-left, tiny pleased surprise. Keep exact character design, exact silhouette, exact nose and mouth and body and all fins and exact image framing, orientation and pixel placement. Do not rotate or move fish, do not add bubbles or parcel. Preserve the original subdued underwater colors and ink style. Truly transparent background. This will be used as a localized eye texture with original body contour retained, so exact alignment matters.
prompts.octopus: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this ORIGINAL lavender octopus with blue-and-white porcelain cup, drawn cel animation style with restrained undersea caustics. Create a new complete coherent pose greeting a dragon visitor located to the LEFT and BELOW the octopus. Turn the head and open eyes to look down-left with a gentle friendly smile; hold the same porcelain teacup slightly forward to the LEFT, as an invitation. Remove the washing sponge and soap foam. All cup grip tentacles anatomically attached; cup and creature one inseparable complete cutout. Several lower tentacle loops rest on one horizontal support baseline, body upright, camera sees slight top of cup. Preserve lavender spots, cream suction cups, brown eyes, blue floral porcelain and original drawing style. No other characters, no table, no text, no glow, no mist, no cast floor shadow. Whole character and cup visible with small margins on truly transparent background.
prompts.wall: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: monochrome ornament ink master to be projected onto existing aged timber wall inserts in an underwater East Asian teahouse. ONLY elegant old Chinese-style curling auspicious cloud scrolls in upper half and flowing running-water ribbons in lower half. A coherent restrained vertical ornamental pattern with generous negative space and broad legible curves. Muted gray-blue brush and mineral pigment strokes, fine imperfect hand-painted edges. Flat frontal elevation, no existing perspective. Actual transparent gaps/background between all strokes. No panel backing, no border, no timber, no frame, no writing, no seals, no yin yang, no bagua, no dragon, no landscape, no objects, no lighting, no shadow, no glow. Tall composition 2:3.
prompts.garden: Use case: compositing. Reference image is ONLY for material, viewing angle and scale context; do NOT reproduce its objects or tray. Generate a single very low continuous hand-formed ceramic miniature landscape insert, long and narrow, viewed slightly from above at the same angle as the reference tray. A shallow asymmetrical celadon porcelain terrain with subdued dark moss-green glaze on low ridges, a thin winding pale blue glazed stream engraved through the center, three broad quiet empty landing zones for separate stone/lily/miniature mountain that will be mounted later. Only terrain insert, NO rocks or flowers or mountains or vegetation standing up, NO tea objects, NO enclosing frame or stand or feet. Keep relief extremely low, like an irregular ceramic tile about 20 times wider than high, long oval footprint. Photographic real glazed ceramic with soft underwater reflections, muted cool greens and slate blues, no studio shine. Transparent background, no cast shadow, no text. Complete insert visible with margins, horizontal composition.
